fields.description: Master switch. With this off the collect endpoint accepts nothing and the script goes quiet.
fields.label: Enable Lead Tracking

fields.description: Record sessions and page views before a visitor identifies. Off means only the submission itself is attributed, with no browsing history.
fields.label: Track Anonymous Visitors

fields.description: Inactivity after which the next page view starts a new session. A new campaign always starts a new session regardless.
fields.label: Session Timeout (minutes)

fields.description: Collect nothing until the page calls CRMTracker.consent(true).
fields.label: Require Consent

fields.description: Drop the last octet (IPv4) or the last 80 bits (IPv6) before storing.
fields.label: Anonymize IP Address

fields.description: Anonymous sessions and events older than this are deleted nightly. History attached to a lead or deal is kept. 0 disables the cleanup.
fields.label: Retention (days)

fields.description: One origin per line (https://www.example.com). The collect endpoint answers only these. Empty means any origin, which is what you want while testing.
fields.label: Allowed Origins

fields.description: One per line. Visits from these addresses are ignored — put your own office here so internal browsing doesn't land in the reports.
fields.label: Excluded IPs
